source: Big Data Bowl 2025 (NFL 2022): plays/player_play weeks 1-9, tracking week(s) [1, 2] for alignment at the snap

method.cohort: isDropback TRUE, not nullified, no spike or kneel, at least one route runner, every route runner and the football present at the snap frame
method.snap: frameType SNAP; lateral offset from the football's y, sign flipped for playDirection 'left' so positive is the QB's left
method.back: route runner more than 2.0 yd behind the ball and within 3.0 yd laterally, or RB/FB within 8.0 yd laterally
method.numbering: side receivers numbered #1 (widest) inward by lateral distance from the ball
method.strong: side with more route runners; equal sides (e.g. 2x2) ordered alphabetically by route tuple, so pairings are order-free
method.alignment: computed alignment counts route runners only; PFF receiverAlignment also counts non-route eligibles

routeVocabulary.notes: HITCH stands for hitch/curl/stick, IN for dig/square-in, CROSS for shallow/drag/over (BDB labels; no depth).

pairings.note: strong | weak side tuples, back routes ignored

allWeeksRbFbByRosterPosition.note: players.csv RB/FB running routes in every week, including those split out

rules: Names apply to exact side tuples ordered from #1 (widest) inward; any other tuple is unnamed (null).
Size 1 sides are named 'Iso <route>' (a label, not a concept). Any side containing SCREEN is 'Screen side'.
HITCH stands for hitch/curl/stick, IN for dig/square-in, CROSS for shallow/drag/over (BDB labels; no depth).
